name: Sakurai Yumemi
source:
An ordinary girl, born in an ordinary family.

After the death of her parents, she is abducted by [url=/c56450]Rengo[/url], who uses her as an incubator for a supposedly legendary insect.

After weeks of torture, rape, and abuse, Yumemi finally gives birth. The only problem is that the insect is a "useless" bug that can't even fight and only seems to be attached to Yumemi.

This is the starting point of the tale about two "useless" beings.

[Based on the [url=https://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/extra/cha/extra_cha_01_1_1.htm]official description[/url]]
